details.question: What are the names of properties that are either houses or apartments with more than 1 room?
details.pred: SELECT DISTINCT p.property_name FROM Properties p JOIN Other_Property_Features opf ON p.property_id = opf.property_id WHERE p.property_type_code IN ('H', 'A') AND p.room_count > 1
